pool_floor.basis: projected full-season playing time, not the rest-of-season remainder

roster_status.basis: StatsAPI rosterType=active (26-man); an optioned or injured player reads off_roster
roster_status.policy: FLAGGED, NEVER FILTERED. This is a rest-of-season board, so a player who is out is still the row a manager most needs to see. The lineup and rotation charts filter instead, because those are claims about tonight.
roster_status.on_failure: a roster walk covering fewer than 28 of 30 clubs flags every player 'unknown' rather than mislabelling whole clubs
